caption: The drawing features a single large bronze bell positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The bell is rendered in varying shades of dark brown and bronze, with darker shading on the left side to suggest a light source from the right. The bell has a flared bottom, two decorative rings near its lower edge, and another raised band just below its shoulder. At the top of the bell is a mounting apparatus, detailed with geometric forms. Encircling the upper part of the bell’s body, above the midline, is an inscription that reads "ELIZABETHTOWN 1745," with the letters embossed and clearly depicted. The bottom of the bell tapers to a small, symmetrical protrusion. The artist's signature, "E. Schwabe," appears in the bottom right corner of the image. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition, leaving the focus solely on the bell.
title: Courthouse Bell
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
